data.one_liner: Android backend for the shared_preferences plugin, storing key‑value data on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: It implements the shared_preferences API for Android, allowing data to be saved using either the native Android SharedPreferences or the newer DataStore Preferences. The package is endorsed and automatically included when using shared_preferences.
use_when: You need persistent key‑value storage on Android via shared_preferences
You want to use SharedPreferencesAsync or SharedPreferencesWithCache with Android‑specific options
avoid_when: You need cross‑platform storage without adding platform‑specific code
You require encrypted or secure storage
strengths: Supports both Android SharedPreferences and DataStore backends
weaknesses: Android‑only; no effect on iOS, web, etc.
Adds native Kotlin/JNI layer, increasing app size

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Single package that works on all platforms without needing platform‑specific imports

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides encrypted storage when security is required

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers fast, pure‑Dart key‑value storage without native code
